THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Divisional Secretary's Ref. No..: Ke.Prale/Ath8/9/(Volume II). I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands required for a public purpose. Purpose of Acquisition: Acquisition of Land for the Construction of a Service Road under the Piliyandala Town Center Development Project. Description of the land to be acquired: Nine (9) allotments of land with an extent of 0.0374 Hectare, depicted as Sheet 11 of Block 15 in Cadastral Map No. 521202, situated in the Village of Mampe West (within the boundaries of Kesbewa Town) in Grama Niladhari Division No. 574, under the Kesbewa Divisional Secretary's Division, in the District of Colombo, Western Province, and described as follows: 1. All persons who are interested in aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Kesbewa on the day of 21st May, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. Furthermore hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 19th day of May, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
